text: dsh-multi-superagent 是面向 DSH Web 的多项目 Superagent 插件：它在一个 DSH 进程中为每个项目挂载独立运行时、状态目录、GitHub 来源和可选的飞书机器人来源。系统把收到的请求按项目策略评估为工单，再为工单创建独立 Session 与工作目录并行执行；主面板提供项目列表、工单状态和管理 API。适合同时维护多个 GitHub 仓库、希望隔离账号与工作上下文的团队。需要本机 DSH、GitHub CLI 账号；飞书接入时还需机器人 lark-cli。

dsh-multi-superagent runs isolated project agents in DSH Web. Each project has its own runtime, GitHub source and optional Feishu bot. Approved requests become tickets with separate sessions and work directories. Manage projects in the panel. Requires DSH and GitHub CLI; Feishu needs a bot lark-cli.
我想让一个 DSH 实例同时处理几个 GitHub 项目。
能不能给不同仓库分别配置账号和工作目录？
希望收到 GitHub Issue 或 PR 后自动评估并分派给代码智能体。
想让多个项目的工单并行执行，而且彼此使用独立 Session。
团队能否从飞书机器人发起代码仓库任务？
我需要一个面板查看和管理多个自动化项目。
Can one DSH process run coding agents for several GitHub repositories?
I want separate sessions and working directories for each automated ticket.
Can a Feishu bot send repository tasks to an agent workflow?
How can I monitor and manage multiple Superagent projects in a web panel?
dsh-multi-superagent 的「多项目运行」功能：在一个 DSH 进程中创建并挂载多个独立项目运行时。通过项目管理 API 创建、更新、重启或移除项目；每个项目使用自己的状态目录和配置。
dsh-multi-superagent 的「GitHub 来源」功能：轮询项目仓库的 Issue、PR 和评论等事件，将触发交给评估与工单流程处理。需为项目配置 GitHub CLI 和仓库。
dsh-multi-superagent 的「飞书来源」功能：可选接收机器人私聊及配置群聊中的消息，并将线程消息送入项目工作流；可配置接收范围与用户准入策略。
dsh-multi-superagent 的「项目管理面板」功能：在 DSH Web 注册侧边栏入口和管理面板，浏览项目并进入对应的项目管理界面。
dsh-multi-superagent 需要 Web server 绑定 loopback 地址；项目管理 API 使用同源与 DSH 连接身份校验。

架构解说：Multi-SA 是 DeepSeek Harness 上的多项目、强隔离、可并行 Superagent（研究原型）。

dsh-multi-superagent README · 为什么做 Multi-SA：官方 / 单仓 [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) 面向**一个** GitHub 仓库：一套 Sources、一套 Policy、一套执行上下文。实际工作里往往要同时推多个仓库（论文仓、产品仓、实验仓……）；若为每个仓各起一整套 Superagent，运维成本高，也容易串配置。

**Multi-SA**（包名 `dsh-multi-superagent`）在同一套 [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) 进程里托管**多个项目**，并保证彼此隔离、可并行：

dsh-multi-superagent README · 为什么做 Multi-SA：- **一项目一仓库**：各自的 GitHub（可选飞书）、允许名单与规则
- **一项目一状态**：`~/.dsh/state/multi-sa/projects/<id>/`，面板与 API 按项目隔离
- **一 Ticket 一 Session / 工作目录**：并发执行时不共用 checkout，不串会话
- **统一运维入口**：一个独立 profile `multi-sa`、一口 `3084`、一套 `scripts/dsh-superagent` 管控启停与健康检查

它仍遵循 Superagent 的用法：**尽量少占人的注意力，尽量多交付有用结果。** 只在有人点名、或团队写好的规则允许时行动；只在必须有人出手、或结果值得看时说话。原则见 [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md)。

dsh-multi-superagent README · 和官方单仓 Superagent 比什么：| | 官方 / 单仓 `dsh-superagent` | Multi-SA（本仓） |
|---|---|---|
| 同时服务的仓库 | **1 个** | **多个**，可并行 |
| 配置与鉴权 | 全局一套 | **按项目隔离**（Sources / Policy / Execution） |
| Ticket 执行 | 单仓 Session / 工作树 | **每 Ticket 独立 Session 与工作目录** |
| 面板 | 单仓视图 | **按项目切换**，待办互不混排 |
| DSH profile | `superagent`（常见口 `3082`） | **独立** `multi-sa`（`127.0.0.1:3084`） |
| 状态目录 | `~/.dsh/state/superagent` | `~/.dsh/state/multi-sa` |
| 控制脚本 | 单仓仓内脚本 | 本仓 `scripts/dsh-superagent`（默认口 3084） |

dsh-multi-superagent README · 面板一览：

① 项目列表：一个 DSH 进程托管多个项目。每个项目有独立的计数、Agent 账号和状态目录，可单独进入、重启、停用或移除。

② 项目概览：标签按处理顺序排列：来源 → 触发 → 评估 → 执行。待人确认的 Ticket 可就地处理；24 小时漏斗显示到达、评估、接受的数量，以及执行器并发。

③ 评估：每条触发只得到一个决定，原因可追溯（例如「名单内的人明确请求，主 Session 接受」）。处理规则在 Policy 中配置。

④ 执行：每个 Ticket 有独立的 Session 与工作目录。可查看执行器状态、按生命周期筛选，并看到 Ticket 的阶段（如 CI 后等待新触发再唤醒）和人工介入点。

Architecture explainer for Multi-SA: multi-project, strongly isolated, parallel Superagent on DeepSeek Harness (research prototype).

dsh-multi-superagent README · Why Multi-SA：The official / single-repo [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) is built for **one** GitHub repository: one Sources setup, one Policy, one execution context. Day-to-day work often spans several repos at once (paper, product, experiments…). Spinning up a full Superagent per repo is heavy to operate and easy to misconfigure across instances.

dsh-multi-superagent README · Why Multi-SA：**Multi-SA** (`dsh-multi-superagent`) hosts **many projects** in one [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) process, with isolation so they can run in parallel:

dsh-multi-superagent README · Why Multi-SA：- **One project, one repository** — its own GitHub (optional Feishu), allowlists, and rules
- **One project, one state tree** — under `~/.dsh/state/multi-sa/projects/<id>/`; panel and APIs stay per project
- **One Ticket, one Session / work directory** — concurrent jobs do not share checkouts or sessions
- **One ops surface** — standalone profile `multi-sa`, port `3084`, and `scripts/dsh-superagent` for start / status / stop

dsh-multi-superagent README · Why Multi-SA：It keeps the Superagent working style: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** Act only when asked or when a team-written rule allows it; speak only when someone must act or can use a result. See [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md).

dsh-multi-superagent README · Compared with official single-repo Superagent：| | Official / single-repo `dsh-superagent` | Multi-SA (this repo) |
|---|---|---|
| Repos served at once | **1** | **Many**, in parallel |
| Config & auth | One global set | **Isolated per project** (Sources / Policy / Execution) |
| Ticket execution | Single-repo Session / worktree | **Separate Session and work directory per Ticket** |
| Panel | Single-repo view | **Per-project switching**, queues stay separate |
| DSH profile | `superagent` (often port `3082`) | **Standalone** `multi-sa` (`127.0.0.1:3084`) |
| State dir | `~/.dsh/state/superagent` | `~/.dsh/state/multi-sa` |
| Control script | that repo's script | this repo's `scripts/dsh-superagent` (defaults to 3084) |

dsh-multi-superagent README · Compared with official single-repo Superagent：**Do not** load `dsh-superagent` and `dsh-multi-superagent` in the same profile: each changes process-wide `PATH` / git settings and needs its own restarts. See the independent-profile section in [docs/006-deployment.md](docs/006-deployment.md).

dsh-multi-superagent README · Panel tour：Screenshots of the local panel (`127.0.0.1:3084`). Project names, repositories, accounts, paths, and Issue / PR text are pixelated. Numbered color boxes mark the key parts (labels are in Chinese).

dsh-multi-superagent README · Panel tour：

① Projects: one DSH process hosts many projects. Each project has its own counters, agent account, and state directory. You can open, restart, disable, or remove each one separately.

② Overview: tabs follow the flow: Sources → Triggers → Evaluation → Execution. Tickets that need a human can be handled in place. A 24-hour funnel shows arrived, evaluated, and accepted counts, plus executor concurrency.

③ Evaluation: each trigger gets exactly one decision, with a traceable reason (for example, "an allowlisted person asked explicitly; the main Session accepted"). Rules live in Policy.
